2. Cross-check of A's brief and its figure

Every checked item in A's prose reproduces from the table: the 11 kWh margin (55% of P3's energy); 73% and 82% cuts versus P2 and P1; the 30 kWh losers' spread, larger than the leader's margin; P2's 2-point clearance; P4's full 5-defect allowance; the flip conditions (P3 under 9 or P4 over 20 kWh).
